name: Vaultwarden
description: Vaultwarden, a lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager server, with PostgreSQL and S3 storage.

DOMAIN.description: Public HTTPS address of this instance, for example https://my-vault.osc-fr1.scalingo.io (use the app name you chose above). Required: used in emails and by the Bitwarden clients.

S3_BUCKET.description: Name of the S3-compatible bucket that stores attachments, Sends, icons and the signing key. Scalingo's disk is erased at every restart, so this is required.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: S3 endpoint URL of your provider, for example https://s3.fr-par.scw.cloud

S3_REGION.description: Region of the bucket, for example fr-par

AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Access key of a user allowed to read and write this bucket only.

AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Secret key that goes with the access key.

ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Secret that opens the /admin page. Generated for you; read it later in this app's environment variables. Leave it empty to disable the admin page.

SIGNUPS_ALLOWED.description: Let anyone who can reach this instance create an account. Set to false once your users have registered.

S3_PATH_STYLE.description: Set to true if your provider requires path-style URLs (https://endpoint/bucket) instead of bucket.endpoint addresses.
